description: Reads every email of one webinar with its wording and its timing: the confirmation email and the five reminder and follow-up emails, each with on or off, subject, heading, preview line, body, and how long before or after the start it goes out. Take it when a host asks what the registrants get, for example "When does the reminder leave?" It needs the session id and the webinar id from wi_list_webinars, and reads only from the connected site. It changes nothing and sends nothing. Without an open connection it says how to connect. Read-only, it changes nothing. Data comes only from the WordPress site this chat is connected to, the site the host approved, never from another site. Without a connected site the answer says what is missing and how to connect: no numbers and no example numbers. Words hosts use: webinar emails, reminder, confirmation mail, when does it go out

session_id.description: From an earlier turn (weiter · texte · stand).

site.description: Which connected site is meant when this chat has more than one: the address exactly as wi_get_connector_status lists it under sites. Leave it out while only one site is connected.

webinar_id.description: The webinar (campaign) id, as wi_list_webinars returned it. Never invent an id.

name: wi_get_webinar_emails
title: Read the webinar emails and their timing
